app.name: Sonic Mania (RSDKv5 Plus)
app.long_description:
Sonic Mania's decompilation with the Plus module: Sonic 1, 2 and CD from their own packs, Sonic Mania's music for them, and the Plus menu (Minus button).
Bring your own game data: copy Data.rsdk to sd:/RSDKv5/, and retro packs to sd:/RSDKv5/retro/.
Add the argument path=/OtherFolder/ to read the data from another folder.
